summary_1line: Krishna rejoices after Ghatotkacha’s death, revealing Karna has wasted his invincible dart, ensuring Arjuna’s survival and explaining earlier strategic killings of dangerous foes.

image_candidates.scene_text: The gigantic dying Ghatotkacha crashes onto the battlefield like a mountain, crushing a mass of Kaurava soldiers beneath his enormous body.
Krishna stands on Arjuna’s chariot shouting and dancing in fierce joy while the grieving Pandavas stare in confusion beside the fallen battlefield.
Krishna leans toward Arjuna on the chariot, revealing that Karna’s divine dart has been spent, while the night battlefield smolders around them.
